**Review: clean (read, not built).** Head df8b9141c. Label: merge-ready. P3 stands (fixes #3024).

What the change does:
- `clipped_screen_segment` clips each outline segment in homogeneous space before the divide, against the depth half-space and a positive-w floor (Liang-Barsky over the two planes). The endpoints go through one transform; non-finite rows drop the segment.
- `push_screen_polyline_runs` builds runs from the clipped segments, not from per-point projection. Visible parts of an edge that crosses the eye plane now draw; the old code dropped the point and lost the part.
- A closed ring keeps its seam: two runs join only where their endpoints match exactly; no bridge edge is ever added across the near-plane gap.
- The three highlight paths (selected, viewport-hover, row-hover) share this code; none has its own projection left here.

Checks I made:
- I traced the adjacency test: two segments that share a visible endpoint produce bitwise-equal homogeneous rows (the t=1 and t=0 interpolations are exact), so runs join on visible vertices and split on clipped ones. The pin `does_not_join_disconnected_visible_runs` covers the split.
- The epsilon floor on w and the `enter > exit` reject are right; the `t.is_finite()` guard covers the parallel case the loop would divide by zero on.
- `closed` requires `n >= 3` and a run longer than 3 with equal ends; the pop keeps the run list open-drawn once, which matches the old `screen` path.
- Seven new pins in `pick_highlight_mesh_tests.rs` with red-before and mutation records in the body; the file layout keeps `pick_highlight_mesh.rs` inside the 400-line rule.
- UI-layer rule: this file uses only egui and its own math; no `sys_*` or world calls. Decision file `docs/decisions/3024-clip-pick-outline.md` is present; Changelog line in the body.

Not built here: runner m3 is busy with run 44851610265 (#3053). Author's quick gate (1,339 pass) and clippy are green on this head per the body; the heavy plan reaches no lane. This is display-only - the pick outlines are an overlay, no posted output changes.
